fields.summary_ko.0: Tesla (TSLA) has launched the Cybercab without a steering wheel at $29,990, though a mandatory $299 monthly autonomous driving subscription is required, bringing the 5-year cost to approximately $47,631.
fields.summary_ko.1: Tesla began Cybercab pre-orders for selected customers on November 13, with delivery potentially affected by NHTSA's safety review results.
